assumptions: Effective composite cp=1200 J/kg/K and through-thickness k=0.5 W/m/K are provisional engineering assumptions, NOT NCAMP measurements.
h_top=h_bottom=50 W/m2/K is a provisional two-air-face convection simplification. It does NOT represent the intended air/composite/tool/contact stack.
Tooling, bag, contact resistance, pressure and consolidation are not modelled; therefore Li 2020 AS4/8552+Invar reference geometry is not reproduced by this solver.
Air schedule is prescribed; manufacturer thermocouple-controlled holds are approximated.
NCAMP resin kinetics/density/Vf are used as a single named demonstration configuration; this is not an authenticated COMPRO implementation.

v03 active domain is composite + 10 mm Invar tool with explicit contact thermal resistance. Legacy cp_composite/k_through/h_bottom fields remain only for backward provenance and are not used by the v03 solver.

Composite cure kinetics/reaction basis remain NCAMP Model 15/NCAMP Vf-Hr, while temperature-dependent constituent transport functions and boundary reference are from Li 2020. This is a documented hybrid demonstration model, not an exact Li reproduction.
Invar rho/cp/k use typical tooling values 8000 kg/m3, 515 J/kg/K, 11 W/m/K from CKN because Li 2020 does not publish these values in the article text.
No numeric cool-down contact degradation is imposed because Li 2020 reports the trend qualitatively but does not provide a fitted conductance.

sources.supports: Model 15 kinetics, Tg, heat of reaction, densities, Vf
2-stage cure ranges, cooling and component release temperature
AS4/8552 constituent thermal-property functions, 10 mm tool geometry, MRCC, top h=85.2, BC1/BC2/BC3 definitions, h_contact=1e5/0 limiting cases and FBG temperature validation layout
Typical Invar density 8000 kg/m3, cp 515 J/kg/K, k 11 W/m/K

composite_transport.model: Li2020 constituent transport functions with team mass-weighted cp; active Vf/rho from NCAMP thermal block
composite_transport.cp_mixing: mass_weighted_by_constituent_mass (team-theory correction; differs from Li Eq.3 volume-weighted cp)

tool.source: CKN tooling typical properties; Li 2020 does not list Invar rho/cp/k in the paper text

notes: Top composite convection h=85.2 W/m2/K follows Li 2020.
Good-contact reference h_contact=1e5 W/m2/K is an extreme comparison condition in Li 2020, not a measured universal contact coefficient.
Default tool outer boundary is prescribed to the commanded autoclave air schedule (BC1-like).
Li 2020 indicates poorer contact during cool-down qualitatively but does not supply a measured numeric cool-down conductance; no invented value is applied.
